title: Remove ASAP/10min/15min/Today timing options and Live Location Tracking from booking form

requirements.summary: Remove 'ASAP', 'Within 10 minutes', 'Within 15 MINUTES', and 'Today' options from the Service Timing dropdown, keeping only 'Within 30 minutes' and 'Within 1 hour'
acceptanceCriteria: The timing dropdown in the booking form contains exactly two options: 'Within 30 minutes' and 'Within 1 hour'
Options 'ASAP', 'Within 10 minutes', 'Within 15 MINUTES', and 'Today' are no longer present in the dropdown
All other form fields (name, phone, email, address, service, etc.) remain unchanged
Form layout, styling, and animations are unchanged

file_operations.description: Remove the timing options 'ASAP', 'Within 10 minutes', 'Within 15 MINUTES', and 'Today' from the Service Timing dropdown select element. Retain only 'Within 30 minutes' and 'Within 1 hour' as valid options. Update the default value if it was set to one of the removed options. Do not modify any other form fields, layout, styling, or animations.

Remove the timing options 'ASAP', 'Within 10 minutes', 'Within 15 MINUTES', and 'Today' from the Service Timing dropdown select element. Retain only 'Within 30 minutes' and 'Within 1 hour' as valid options. Update the default value if it was set to one of the removed options. Do not modify any other form fields, layout, styling, or animations.

requirements.summary: Remove the Live Location Tracking section/feature entirely from the booking form UI while preserving the address input field and IP-based auto-fill functionality
acceptanceCriteria: No 'Live Location Tracking' button, map, or live GPS tracking UI element is visible in the booking form
The address text input field is still present and editable by the user
IP-based address auto-fill (city, region, country from ipapi.co) still works if previously implemented
Hidden latitude/longitude fields remain if previously added
Form layout, styling, and animations are unchanged

file_operations.description: Remove all UI elements related to Live Location Tracking including any buttons, map components, or GPS tracking features. Ensure the address text input field remains present and editable. Preserve the IP-based auto-fill functionality using ipapi.co. Keep any hidden latitude/longitude fields if they exist. Do not modify form layout, styling, or animations.

Remove all UI elements related to Live Location Tracking including any buttons, map components, or GPS tracking features. Ensure the address text input field remains present and editable. Preserve the IP-based auto-fill functionality using ipapi.co (via useIpLocation hook). Keep any hidden latitude/longitude fields if they exist. Do not modify form layout, styling, or animations.
